morphology.pattern_note: 词根无音变；semoga 添加 se-，moga-moga 通过完整重叠构成，并非添加词缀。

senses.zh_definition: 表示愿望、祝福或祈求：愿；但愿；希望。
senses.en_definition: Used to introduce a wish, blessing, or prayer: may; hopefully.
senses.nuances: 通常置于所祝愿的事情之前，表达愿望而非保证结果。moga、semoga 和 moga-moga 意义相近；正式祝辞常用 semoga。此处收录祝愿义，不包括吉兰丹方言中表示物品或事情的同形词。释义依据：[DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=moga)。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Moga kerjasama ini membawa manfaat yang berkekalan kepada kedua-dua pihak.
dual_scenarios.zh: 愿此次合作为双方带来长远的益处。
dual_scenarios.en: May this collaboration bring lasting benefits to both parties.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Moga cepat sembuh, ya. Rehat je dulu.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Semoga awak cepat sembuh. Berehatlah dahulu.
dual_scenarios.zh: 祝你快点好起来呀，先好好休息。
dual_scenarios.en: Hope you get well soon. Just rest for now.
spoken_features: ya 缓和语气并表达关心
je 是 sahaja 的口语形式

messages.speaker: Aina (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku dah balik dari klinik, nak tidur dulu.
messages.ms_standard: Saya sudah pulang dari klinik dan mahu tidur dahulu.
messages.zh: 我已经从诊所回来了，想先睡一会儿。
messages.en: I'm back from the clinic. I'm going to get some sleep.

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Moga cepat sembuh, ya. Rehat je dulu, nanti aku mesej lagi.
messages.ms_standard: Semoga awak cepat sembuh. Berehatlah dahulu; saya akan menghantar mesej lagi nanti.
messages.zh: 祝你快点好起来呀。先休息，我晚点再发消息给你。
messages.en: Hope you get well soon. Get some rest; I'll text you again later.

etymology.historical_story: Moga belongs to a Malay family of hopeful expressions that includes semoga and moga-moga. Its cultural interest lies in how a short word turns a statement into a wish: recovery, happiness, or protection becomes something sincerely hoped for. DBP records it in prayerful examples, showing the connection between ordinary goodwill and devotional language without establishing a particular ancient borrowing route. [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=moga)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mo-ga 联想成轻轻说出的“愿你……”：moga berjaya，愿你成功。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 适合祝福朋友、同事或长辈；给长辈或正式收件人的完整祝辞可用 semoga，并配合适当称谓。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 可用于宗教或非宗教祝愿；提及 Allah 或具体宗教内容时应顾及对方信仰。慰问时宜表达关心，避免以祝愿代替对方所需的实际回应。
